item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/May/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now over central China will develop into a cold front tomorrow morning, and move across the coast of Guangdong later tomorrow. There will be showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon in the following couple of days, the weather will be slightly cooler over Guangdong. Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to the region. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China midweek next week. The easterly airstream is expected to be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will rise progressively over the region.
